claims.text: What the strip looks like Small q, tall R in I and aVL; small r, deep S in II, III and aVF.
claims.quote: rS complexes in leads II, III, aVF, with small R waves and deep S waves qR complexes in leads I, aVL, with small Q waves and tall R waves

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Axis: left axis deviation (−45° to −90°)
I and aVL: small Q (qR complexes)
claims.quote: Small Q in I and aVL, small R in II, III, aVF

claims.text: II, III, aVF: small R, deep S (rS complexes)
claims.quote: Small Q in I and aVL, small R in II, III, aVF
QRS < 120 ms Left Posterior Fascicular Block

claims.text: R-wave peak time in aVL: > 45 ms
claims.quote: Prolonged R wave peak time in aVL > 45ms

claims.text: Causes (mechanism and diagnoses) Mechanism: impulses reach the LV via the posterior fascicle, which inserts into the inferoseptal wall
claims.quote: In LAFB, impulses are conducted to the left ventricle (LV) via the posterior fascicle, which inserts into the inferoseptal wall of the LV along its endocardial surface

claims.text: Spread: the main wave of depolarization is slightly delayed and spreads upward and leftward — tall R waves in left-sided leads, deep S waves inferiorly
claims.quote: The major wave of depolarisation is slightly delayed and spreads upwards and leftwards, producing tall R waves in left-sided leads and deep S waves in inferior leads

claims.text: The same heart disorders as LBBB; isolated LAFB is fairly common and does not on its own raise cardiac risk
claims.quote: The associations between hemiblocks and a structural heart disorder are the same as for LBBB. Isolated left posterior hemiblock is rare. Isolated left anterior hemiblock is more common and does not appear to be independently associated with an increased risk of future cardiac events or mortality.

claims.text: Symptoms and treatment Usually no symptoms; no specific treatment is indicated
claims.quote: There are usually no symptoms, but presence of either suggests a heart disorder. Diagnosis is by electrocardiography. No specific treatment is indicated.
